root_idea.summary: The root centers on standing at or overlooking the limit of something; healing is understood as overcoming and prevailing over illness.
root_idea.development: From the notion of being on a brink or overlooking something, the lexicon connects شفاء with prevailing over disease. Related developments include the edge or brink of a thing, seeking or providing healing, and lip- and mouth-related vocabulary.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form I verb group displayed under its normalized perfect-tense dictionary citation form.
Quran-attested nominal group displayed as the standard noun شِفَاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Healing; overcoming illness and restoring health.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun associated with prevailing over disease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek healing or a cure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for seeking a means of recovery from illness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The edge, extremity, or brink of a thing; a small remaining portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same lexical branch can describe being at an edge or having only a little left.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To provide someone with something by which healing is sought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction taking the thing supplied as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach or be on the verge of something, especially death; to draw near an endpoint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person near death and figuratively of the sun nearing sunset.
The entry also discusses related diminutive and plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having lips that do not close together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of the condition of the lips.
A physical adjective formed from شَفَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Face-to-face oral communication; speaking directly from mouth to mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for direct spoken exchange rather than written or mediated communication.

other_classical_meanings.definition: He distracted or preoccupied me from something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anomalous lexical use construed with عن and the matter from which someone is diverted.
